ImageDescription.value:
Ensemble of national dance “SABO” was found at Tashkent Municipal Public Association “Assalom Kuyosh”in 2003 being attached to Central Railway main Palace of Culture.

Permanent organizer and artistic director of Ensemble is candidate of pedagogic science Mirzaeva Muborak Gayratovna. Head ballet-master is Folk Artist of Uzbek Republic Kadyr Muminov. Also many of professional ballet-masters, tutors and pedagogues work at ensemble. Principal activity of ensemble “SABO” is keeping, development and popularization of traditional national dances, musics and costumes. The main backbone of the collective made up by young pupils of company “Assalom Kuyosh” and graduates of High School of national Dance. There are 18 young ladies and 4 young men of age 16-22 in collective.

Repertoire of ensemble is made of folk and classic dances, folk Uzbek dances of all regions of Uzbek Republic (Bukhara, Khorezm, Fergana, Mountain dances, dances of Zarafshan Valley), and also of dances of world nations (Spanish, Gipsy, Greek, Russian, Latin, Arab and others), and modern shows.
